subject: food-technology
title: Knife Safety
welcome_lead: Sharp knife, safe hands, steady board.
meta_desc: KS3 food: knife safety, bridge and claw grip.
final_note: A safe cook is a chef with all 10 fingers.

concepts.def: Cuts cleanly, less likely to slip.

walkthroughs.body_html: The bridge grip: place thumb and forefinger either side of the food like a bridge. Cut down between them. Good for round things like onions cut in half first.
The claw grip: curl your fingertips back, knuckles forward, against the food. The blade rests on your knuckles. Used for slicing thin pieces safely.
Put a damp cloth under the chopping board so it doesn't slide. Sharp knives are safer than blunt — blunt knives skid off food onto fingers.
